title: The two kinds of AI attacker CERT-In flagged, and the weaknesses they exploited | HT Explainers
body: The warning came on October 15 from the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In), the agency under the ministry of electronics and information technology that responds to cyber attacks on Indian networks. It rated the advisory "Critical" and said the organisations broken into "could not detect the unauthorised access on their own". CERT-In learnt of the incidents from AI companies that owned up, from its own forensic work on suspicious activity, and from hunting for threats on its own. [...] The advisory sets out seven measures for AI developers, research laboratories and the agencies that test their models. Testing should happen behind a network that blocks all outside connections by default and lets through only the destinations a task strictly needs, and CERT-In wants that block enforced in the network itself, "not through instructions to the model". Tests should use fake targets, fake passwords and throwaway computers, with real data and real credentials kept out. title: CERT-In warns Apple users of active cyber attacks: List of devices that are at risk, update your iPhone, iPad and Mac now
body:
CERT-In has warned Apple users in India about a high-severity security vulnerability affecting iPhones, iPads and Macs. The flaw is reportedly being actively exploited in sophisticated targeted attacks. Apple has released security updates to address the issue, and users are advised to update their devices immediately and avoid opening suspicious files or attachments. [...] The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) has warned that there is a critical security flaw in a number of Apple operating systems that could pose severe risks to users in India. The agency has said that the vulnerability is already being used in targeted attacks, so it’s especially crucial to upgrade software with older versions. [...] The information provided indicates that the attacks reported are targeted against specific users, but other users should patch their devices as the underlying vulnerability is still present on unpatched devices.

The most obvious lesson for Apple fans in India is to ensure that their iPhone, iPad or Mac is running the latest software update and get it as soon as possible. Users should be mindful of unsolicited files and attachments, even if from trusted sources.

title: Arm Unveils AI Chip, Partners With Meta and OpenAI - Business Insider
body:
Arm has long run its business as an architect behind the scenes, designing chips that power almost all the world's smartphone and making money off royalties from the chips it designs for customers.

Now, Arm is changing it up by announcing its own AI chip, the Arm AGI CPU. [...] With energy constraints and memory shortages, the AI boom has created a massive bottleneck in data centers. Faced with this demand, Arm stepped up with an AI chip that it says is more energy-efficient. Arm says it sees a $1.5 trillion market opportunity as it moves into AI chips for cloud, edge, and physical AI. [...] Arm CEO Rene Haas said Tuesday at a company conference that this massive pivot wasn't just an internal strategy shift—it was a direct plea from the world's most powerful AI giants. The company name-dropped OpenAI and Meta as major partners for this chip.

"The biggest reason we're doing this is that our partners have asked for it," Haas said Tuesday.
